paragraphs.text: Right-sidebar two-person password chat for DeepSeek Harness; messages never touch disk.
# AB-BA Secret Chat · dsh-abba-secret-chat
A one-off, two-person password chat that docks in the **DeepSeek Harness** right sidebar. A and B ea
ch set a password and tell each other; **both must match** to pair. It is **end-to-end encrypted** —
messages and images are encrypted in your browsers, so the server (and anyone sniffing the network)
sees only ciphertext, and **only someone who knows both passwords can read them**. Nothing is store
d or logged, and **everything disappears when DSH exits**.
English | 中文
*A “Secret chat” entry appears at the bottom of the left sidebar; the chat opens in the right sideba
r next to your main conversation, which keeps working untouched.*
## What it solves
Sometimes you want to say a few private things to someone nearby (a colleague, family member, a frie
nd) without creating accounts, leaving chat history behind, or mixing it into your AI session. Two p
eople each know a password, one click opens a room that only exists while both are in it — and burns
know a password, one click opens a room that only exists while both are in it — and burns after use.
## Features
- **Sidebar chat** — a **🔒 Secret chat** button at the bottom of the left sidebar (icon-only when na
rrow) opens a “Secret chat” tab in the **right sidebar**; the chat page is embedded in that tab. It

can also be opened from the right sidebar’s “+” page. Your main conversation is unaffected.
- **End-
to-end encryption** — both passwords stay in the browser and only drive key derivation (SHA-256 → PB
KDF2-HMAC-SHA256 → AES-256-CBC with HMAC-SHA256 integrity). The server receives a pairing hash and c
iphertext only: no passwords, no readable content. Packet capture on the same Wi-Fi sees ciphertext

too.
- **Two-password pairing** — the A field takes A’s password and the B field takes B’s password;
only when both are correct do two people meet. **Swapping the fields still works** (the pairing key

is order-independent).
- **Two people per combination** — a third person using the same pair is rej
ected. If either side leaves, refreshes, or disconnects, the room is destroyed and both sides are cl

eared immediately.
- **Images and screenshots** — pick, paste, or drag an image, or click **Screensh
ot** to capture what is currently visible on screen. Both are compressed, encrypted, and sent; the p
eer can open them full-size. Screen capture inside the DSH right sidebar needs the host to allow it;
when denied the page tells you to use “Open in browser”. (Browsers only expose screen capture on a

secure origin, so a LAN guest on plain `http://192.168.x.x` gets a hint instead.)
- **“Me / You” lab
els** — no names are shown anywhere; each bubble is labelled 「我」 (me) or 「你」 (you) from your own poi

nt of view.
- **Full cleanup on end** — keys are dropped, messages and images are removed, the live
connection is closed; the server destroys the room and its queues at the same time. The page uses no

cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, or IndexedDB.
- **Works on your LAN** — a tiny zero-dependen
cy HTTP service on `8787` (falls back `+1…+9`, then OS-assigned) lets the other person join from a b

rowser on the same Wi-Fi with **nothing installed**.
[该节后续省略]
## Install
Requires **DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.3`** (`engines.dsh`; earlier hosts lack the right sidebar a
nd the `sidebarRight` API). The current version is fully tested on **DSH 0.2.2-rc.1** (and 0.2.1-rc.
the `sidebarRight` API). The current version is fully tested on **DSH 0.2.2-rc.1** (and 0.2.1-rc.5).
**A. From the market (once listed)**
DSH → left sidebar **Plugins** → **Market** → search `dsh-abba-secret-chat` → Install.
**B. From a local directory (desktop)**
DSH desktop → left sidebar **Plugins** → **Install** → **local directory** → point at this package →
Install, then **fully quit and reopen DSH**.
**C. Command line (plain `dsh web` or a custom profile)**
[代码示例省略，未执行]
> The desktop profile is owned by the desktop app’s plugin manager — install through the in-app Plug
ins page instead of editing `profiles/desktop` by hand.
Restart DSH after installing or updating so the new plugin loads.
## Three-step usage
1. **Agree on passwords** — A and B each pick a password (4–128 chars) and tell each other **out of

band**. Those two passwords are the only secret: they pair the room and unlock decryption.
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy and security
- **End-to-end encryption** — the two passwords only drive local derivation: `hA/hB = SHA256(passwor
d)`, sorted and hashed again into the pairing key sent to the server; the encryption key (`PBKDF2(hA
|hB)`) and MAC key are derived separately and **never sent**. Messages use AES-256-CBC with a random
IV plus HMAC-SHA256, verified before decryption. The server and network sniffers see only ciphertex

t and a pairing hash; reading content requires both passwords.
- **Memory only** — rooms, members, a
nd ciphertext live in process memory; nothing is written to a database or file, and message content

is never logged.
- **No browser storage** — the page uses no cookies, `localStorage`, `sessionStorag

e`, or IndexedDB.
- **Plain HTTP (content still encrypted)** — the page itself is served over plain
HTTP on the LAN (default `0.0.0.0:8787`), but messages and images are application-layer encrypted, s
o captures show ciphertext. Use it on a trusted network; **anyone who knows both passwords can join*

*.
- **Isolated from your DSH session** — the chat page is a separate web page; its content never en

ters DSH session history or the model. The plugin registers no model-facing tools.
- **Lifecycle** —
the service starts and stops with the DSH process; no resident background process or system service
the service starts and stops with the DSH process; no resident background process or system service.
## Compatibility
| Host | Notes |
| DSH Desktop `>= 0.2.2-rc.1` | Fully tested (right-sidebar tab, entry, encrypted chat in the panel,

images, `/abba`) |
| DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` and earlier rcs | Satisfies `engines.dsh`; UI and service are

host-version agnostic, but upgrading to 0.2.2-rc.1 is recommended |
| `dsh web` (same version) | Sa

me right sidebar and entry |
| Older hosts (no right sidebar) | `engines.dsh` not satisfied; the ent
ry degrades to opening the chat page in a browser tab |
